comments-empty: No comments yet. Pin the first one to this moment.
comments-limit: Comment limit reached for this track.
comments-no-track: Play a track to see its comments.
error-save: Couldn't save that change. Try again.
error-signed-out: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
first-note-hint-keys: Press A, S, D, F, G, H, J or K on your computer keyboard. A is C4.
first-note-hint-mic: Play one note on your instrument, or sing one, near the microphone.
first-note-hint-midi: Press any key on your MIDI controller.
first-note-hint-screen: Tap any key on the piano below.
hero-subtitle: 친구들과 Spotify 미리듣기를 들어보세요. 함께 즐기세요.
input-keys-desc: Keys A to K play C4 to C5. W, E, T, Y and U are the black keys.
input-mic-desc: For guitar or voice. Works best in a quiet room.
input-midi-desc: The most accurate way to play: a digital piano or keyboard over USB or Bluetooth.
input-screen-desc: Tap the piano on your screen. Always works.
latency-hint-keys: Press A on your keyboard on each click.
latency-hint-mic: Play or sing a short note on each click.
latency-hint-midi: Press a key on your controller on each click.
latency-hint-screen: Tap the pad on each click.
latency-intro: You will hear 8 clicks. Play along with each one. This tells lessons how much delay your setup adds.
latency-no-audio: Sound can't play in this browser, so timing can't be checked.
latency-result: Done. Your setup adds about {{ms}} ms. Lessons will allow for it.
latency-retry: We didn't catch enough taps. Try again and play on every click.
lesson-save-failed: Couldn't save your progress. Check your connection and try again.
lesson-unavailable-body: This lesson isn't ready yet. Pick another one from your learning path.
mic-blocked: Microphone access was blocked. To allow it, tap the lock or settings icon next to the address bar, turn on the microphone for this site, then try again.
mic-failed: The microphone couldn't start. Another app may be using it. Close it and try again.
mic-listening: Listening… play or sing a note.
mic-not-found: No microphone was found. Connect one, or check that it is turned on.
midi-blocked: MIDI access was blocked. Allow MIDI devices for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
midi-failed: MIDI couldn't start in this browser.
midi-no-device: Plug in or pair a MIDI controller. It will show up here.
midi-try: Play a key: it lights up here.
midi-unsupported-hint: iPhone and iPad browsers cannot use MIDI. Use the on-screen keys or the microphone, or open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
not-configured: 이 서버에서 음악 검색이 설정되지 않았습니다.
not-quite: 아쉽네요 — 다른 힌트나 추측을 시도해 보세요.
sleep-timer-off: 수면 타이머가 꺼져 있습니다. 클릭하여 설정하세요.
